steps: Ask a helper to take the photo with the rear camera from about 1.5 m using 2–3× zoom, or put the phone on a stand at eye level and use the timer or voice control.
Please do not take an arm's-length selfie: at short distances the nose and mid-face look larger than they are.
Stand in front of a plain, light background with even light on your face.
Pull your hair back so your hairline and temples are visible, and take off glasses.
Keep your head level and look straight at the lens.
Relax your face: neutral expression, lips gently closed.
frontal.title: How to take the front photo

steps: Turn exactly sideways to the camera (90°), taken the same way as the front photo.
Use a plain background that contrasts with your skin and hair.
Tuck your hair behind your ear and keep the camera level.
Look straight ahead at a point at eye level.
Keep your chin and some of your neck visible, with your collar below your chin and nothing in front of your face or neck.
profile.title: How to take the side photo

disclaimer.consult: Please consult a licensed plastic surgeon in person before making any decision.
disclaimer.general: This app shows measurements of facial proportions for information only. It is not a medical diagnosis or a treatment recommendation. Measurements depend on the photo and have limited precision, and proportions differ naturally between people. If you are considering any procedure, please consult a licensed plastic surgeon in person.

hint.avoid_glare: Avoid strong light or deep shadows on your face.
hint.distance_unverified: The camera distance could not be checked for this photo.
hint.face_in_frame: Make sure your whole face, from hairline to chin, is inside the photo.
hint.face_too_small: Your face is too small in the photo. Zoom in (2–3×) or use a higher-resolution camera instead of moving closer.
hint.head_level: Keep your head level, without tilting it.
hint.hold_still: Hold still and make sure the camera is focused on your face.
hint.less_light: Reduce the light on your face or avoid direct light.
hint.more_light: Find brighter, even light on your face.
hint.move_back: Move the camera a little farther away (about 1.5 m) and use 2–3× zoom.
hint.multiple_faces: More than one face was found. Only the person being measured should be in the photo.
hint.neutral_expression: Relax your face into a neutral expression.
hint.no_face: No face was found. Face the camera so your whole face is visible.
hint.open_eyes: Keep your eyes open and look at the lens.
hint.profile_background: Use a plain background that contrasts with your skin and hair.
hint.profile_facing: Turn so that your nose points to the side shown in the app.
hint.profile_in_frame: Keep your whole profile, from forehead to neck, inside the photo, with nothing in front of your face or neck.
hint.profile_level: Keep your head level and look straight ahead at a point at eye level.
hint.profile_pose: Turn exactly sideways, close your lips gently, and keep hair, hands and clothing away from your face outline.
hint.relax_smile: Relax your face into a neutral expression, without smiling.
hint.turn_left: Turn your head slightly to your left.
hint.turn_right: Turn your head slightly to your right.

alar_crease.instruction: Place the point where the side of your nose meets your cheek.
alar_crease.name: Side of the nose

glabella.instruction: Slide the point along the outline to the most forward point between your eyebrows.
glabella.name: Forehead between the eyebrows

labrale_inferius.instruction: Slide the point to the most forward point of your lower lip.
labrale_inferius.name: Lower lip

labrale_superius.instruction: Slide the point to the most forward point of your upper lip.
labrale_superius.name: Upper lip

menton.instruction: Slide the point to the lowest point of your chin.
menton.name: Bottom of the chin

nasion.instruction: Slide the point to the deepest point between your forehead and nose.
nasion.name: Top of the nose

pronasale.instruction: Slide the point to the most forward point of your nose.
pronasale.name: Nose tip

soft_tissue_pogonion.instruction: Slide the point to the most forward point of your chin.
soft_tissue_pogonion.name: Chin

subnasale.instruction: Slide the point to where the base of your nose meets your upper lip.
subnasale.name: Base of the nose

trichion.instruction: Drag the point to where your hairline meets your forehead, in the middle of your face.
trichion.name: Hairline

reference.note: Reference ranges describe classical proportions or typical measurements. Faces differ naturally, and values outside a range are common.

strings.side_note: Right and left refer to your own right and left.

status.inconclusive: Too close to the reference limit to tell apart from measurement variation
status.unavailable: Could not be measured from this photo

warning.distance_unverified: The camera distance could not be verified, so these measurements are shown for information only.
warning.no_frontal_scale: Millimetre values need the front photo from the same session, so only proportions are shown.
